description: This source file contains unit tests for the `ExecApprovalsSocketPathGuard` functionality related to managing socket paths, including directory permissions and handling symlink and regular file cases.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSocketPathGuardTests
classes.description: A suite of tests verifying behavior of the socket path guard, including directory permission setting and socket removal rules.

methods.name: `harden parent directory creates directory with0700 permissions`
methods.description: Tests that the parent directory of a socket path is created with 0700 permissions.

methods.name: `remove existing socket rejects symlink path`
methods.description: Tests that attempting to remove a socket at a symlink path properly rejects the operation with an appropriate error.

methods.name: `remove existing socket rejects regular file path`
methods.description: Tests that attempting to remove a non-socket regular file correctly rejects the operation with an appropriate error.
